questions.stem: What is the inverse square law in relation to light intensity and photosynthesis experiments?

options.text: Doubling the distance from a light source halves the light intensity
Doubling the distance from a light source doubles the light intensity
Halving the distance from a light source halves the light intensity
Doubling the distance from a light source quarters the light intensity

questions.explanation: According to the inverse square law, light intensity is inversely proportional to the square of the distance. Doubling the distance results in one quarter of the original light intensity.
